summary: The blueprint broadly covers healthy human pancreas, but needs targeted refinement of endothelial/mural resolution, immune coverage, and several subtype marker modules.

issues.description: Lymphatic endothelium is represented only as a positive program gated by vascular endothelial identity, with no blood-endothelial negative module or independent identity axis.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a pan-endothelial gate if useful, keep blood vascular and lymphatic endothelial modules separate, and represent lymphatics with a plain lymphatic identity axis and/or a gated lymphatic-vs-blood-endothelial contrast.

issues.description: The mural module combines pericyte and vascular smooth-muscle markers, while the axis gates the same module by itself and mostly duplicates mural_cell_identity.
issues.suggested_fix: Split pericyte and vascular smooth-muscle programs and replace the self-gated mural bias with a pericyte-vs-smooth-muscle gated or contrast axis.

issues.description: The immune compartment lacks an explicit dendritic/APC axis, and T/NK plus B/plasma are merged into coarse modules.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a dendritic/APC module and gated axis distinct from macrophage genes; if dimensionality permits, split T from NK and B from plasma programs.

issues.description: The centroacinar/ductal module includes stress or nonspecific genes such as TFF1, MMP7, and SPINK1, weakening its specificity for baseline centroacinar cells.
issues.suggested_fix: Tighten the module around canonical ductal/centroacinar transport, junction, and epithelial markers such as CA2, CLDN10, CFTR, SOX9, KRT19, and SLC4A4; reserve TFF1/MMP7 for a separate stress axis only if intended.

issues.description: Some endocrine subtype modules include generic endocrine genes already covered by the endocrine gate or less subtype-specific markers, which may blur beta, PP, and epsilon subtype axes.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep generic neuroendocrine genes mainly in endocrine_islet and make beta, PP, and epsilon modules more subtype-specific; treat DLK1 as an immature/fetal beta-state marker only if that state is intentionally modeled.

out_of_scope: No placeholders or orphan-module structural problems were found; python3 embedder_blueprint.py --describe exits cleanly.
